jobs.title: Sr. Satellite Flight Software Engineer - TeraWave
jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.

Job Description

This position is part of Blue Origin's TeraWave business unit, a newly announced satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. TeraWave consists of 5,408 optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise-grade connectivity for critical operations.

We are seeking a Senior Satellite Flight Software Engineer to provide technical expertise for TeraWave's Satellite Flight Software Subsystem. This role will be instrumental in developing robust, scalable flight software to support the growth of TeraWave into a 5,408-vehicle constellation. The ideal candidate is a hands-on flight software architect who will shape software architecture, drive cross-functional integration, and establish high standards for software quality, verification, security, and maintainability across the full flight software lifecycle.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Architect, design, develop, and integrate core flight software for a next-generation satellite platform
Define scalable, reusable, and platform-independent flight software frameworks, services, and design patterns to support multiple spacecraft configurations and future growth
Architect, develop, and evolve key flight software components including core services, command and data handling (C&DH), telemetry, health monitoring, and fault-management infrastructure
Establish software architecture standards, coding guidelines, design patterns, and review practices to ensure maintainability, reliability, and mission readiness
Partner closely with systems, avionics, GNC, communications, power, propulsion, thermal, payload, and autonomy teams to translate vehicle and subsystem-level requirements into robust software implementations
Conduct software design reviews, code reviews, and technical trade studies related to performance, fault tolerance, redundancy, scalability, and portability
Support software integration, verification, and validation in software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and other mission-representative test environments
Develop and improve software engineering infrastructure including build systems, CI/CD pipelines, automated test frameworks, and debugging/diagnostic tools
Contribute to technical documentation including software architecture descriptions, interface control documents, verification plans, and test procedures
Design and implement secure OTA software update capabilities for spacecraft, including validation, authenticated delivery, rollback, version control, and safe deployment in mission-critical on-orbit environments
Ensure flight software architecture and implementation incorporate cybersecurity principles such as secure communications, access control, interface hardening, and resilient software design

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical field
8+ years of experience developing embedded software for spacecraft or other mission-critical real-time systems
Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python
Experience with RTOS-based embedded software development with Embedded Linux, VxWorks, or QNX
Experience architecting and implementing complex flight software or mission-critical embedded software systems
Demonstrated technical depth across software design, implementation, and cross-functional integration
Experience with software lifecycle, configuration management, CI/CD, and verification/validation practices for mission-critical systems
Familiarity with communication protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, CAN, I2C, SPI, and RS-422/485
Experience applying secure software development and cybersecurity best practices in embedded or mission-critical systems
Experience with embedded software testing methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience with flight software frameworks such as core Flight System (cFS), F Prime, or similar
Experience developing software for satellite constellations, distributed space systems, or networked embedded platforms
Knowledge of satellite communications systems, spacecraft networking, and high-throughput data handling
Experience with software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and integrated spacecraft test environments
Experience with fault-tolerant computing, redundancy management, and resilient software architectures
Knowledge of radiation-hardened computing environments and software considerations for spaceflight
Experience with communication satellite systems, optical inter-satellite links, or related networking technologies
Experience designing secure over-the-air (OTA) software update mechanisms for embedded or mission-critical systems
Experience with software build systems, static analysis, code quality tooling, or automated verification frameworks for embedded systems

Why Blue Origin

At Blue Origin, we’re building the future of space-based connectivity through the TeraWave satellite communications network. As a Senior Satellite Flight Software Developer, you will help define the software architecture, engineering rigor, and technical foundation for a large-scale satellite constellation delivering high-performance, resilient global communications. Join a team solving complex, mission-critical problems at the intersection of spacecraft, software, networking, and system integration.

Join our team and be part of building a space-based network designed for tomorrow, where your expertise will directly contribute to creating a system that provides connectivity anywhere on Earth.

Base Pay Range For

CA applicants is $197,529.00 - $276,539.55 CO applicants is $181,626.00 - $254,275.35 WA applicants is $197,529.00 - $276,539.55

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.

Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Software Engineering Internship
jobs.description:
T-Mobile is synonymous with innovation–and you could be part of the team that disrupted an entire industry! We reinvented customer service, brought real 5G to the nation, and now we’re shaping the future of technology in wireless and beyond. Our work is as exciting as it is rewarding, so consider the career opportunity below as your invitation to grow with us, make big things happen with us, above all, #BEYOU with us. Together, we won’t stop!

Get hands-on experience, training—and a leg up on a bright future.

T-Mobile didn’t become a leader by following the playbook. We got here by breaking it. We’re a disruptor that now plays on a higher tier, and we’re still raising the bar for millions of customers nationwide. If you want to work somewhere that sets the standard instead of matching it, this is your place.

This is an 11-week paid learning experience where you’ll do real work, not busywork. You’ll build relationships with other interns and leaders across the company, and you’ll be paired with mentors who will challenge you to grow skills that matter. We’ll give you hands-on projects with real stakes, and we expect your creativity and sharp ideas to make an immediate impact. You’ll work alongside T-Mobile employees who have your back and who still believe the best ideas can come from anyone.

What It’s Like

Our engineering team builds and maintains the technology behind digital out-of-home advertising. We connect advertisers with media owners and help campaigns get planned, purchased, and delivered at scale. We’re small enough that your work gets seen and big enough that it matters. A typical week mixes building features, reviewing code with teammates, joining technical discussions, and checking in with product and QA. Collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning set the pace.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and improve software used in real advertising workflows. Your projects will span frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. You’ll help solve complex technical and business challenges, with the chance to own features and see your work reach production.

Key Responsibilities

Build, test, and maintain features across frontend applications and backend services
Partner with engineers, product managers, and QA to turn requirements into working solutions
Contribute to code reviews, debugging, testing, and technical discussions
Investigate issues and identify improvements that raise software quality and reliability
Apply engineering best practices, development tools, and modern technologies

What It Takes

Foundational knowledge of programming concepts, data structures, and software development principles
Experience with at least one language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Java
Familiarity with web development, REST APIs, SQL, Git, or AWS is a plus
Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a drive to learn new technologies
Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the initiative to take ownership
No prior internship needed. Academic, personal, and open-source projects count

Minimum Qualifications

At least 18 years of age
Legally authorized to work in the United States now and in the future
Must have one or more course(s) remaining in a Bachelors or Graduate degree program post internship
Employees of T-Mobile or Metro by T-Mobile are ineligible for external Summer Internships, please see Magenta Accelerator if interested

Relocation assistance will be provided to program participants who reside more than 50 miles from the internship location.

Intern wages range from $27/hour to $50/hour. The successful candidate’s actual pay will be based on education/STEM vs non-STEM designation.

Never stop growing!

As part of the T-Mobile team, you know the Un-carrier doesn’t have a corporate ladder–it’s more like a jungle gym of possibilities! We love helping our employees grow in their careers, because it’s that shared drive to aim high that drives our business and our culture forward. By applying for this career opportunity, you’re living our values while investing in your career growth–and we applaud it. You’re unstoppable!

T-Mobile USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All decisions concerning the employment relationship will be made without regard to age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, religious affiliation, marital status, citizenship status, veteran status, the presence of any physical or mental disability, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Discrimination, retaliation or harassment based upon any of these factors is wholly inconsistent with how we do business and will not be tolerated.

Talent comes in all forms at the Un-carrier. If you are an individual with a disability and need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know by emailing ApplicantAccommodation@t-mobile.com or calling 1-844-873-9500. Please note, this contact channel is not a means to apply for or inquire about a position and we are unable to respond to non-accommodation related requests.

jobs.description:

June 7, 2027

Assist in developing and testing search algorithms and models.

Collaborate with team members to improve search performance and relevance.

Exposure to machine learning libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn) and technologies (LangChain, LangSmith) is a plus.
Eager to learn and experiment with new technologies in a collaborative environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Adaptability, flexibility, and willingness to learn new things quickly
Understanding of search platforms (Elasticsearch, Solr) is a bonus.
Basic knowledge of big data tools (Hadoop, Spark) is beneficial.
Previous projects or coursework related to search, ML, or AI are highly valued.
Enjoy working in teams and being highly communicative
Able to multitask and be flexible to new initiatives

Position #2: Title: Software Engineer for UI (Frontend)

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain front-end components using React.js.
Assist in building and integrating backend APIs using Node.js.
Collaborate with the design and development teams to implement user-friendly UI/UX.
Debug and optimize code for performance and scalability.
Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in web development.

What's Needed - Basic Qualifications:

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Familiarity with React.js and its core principles.
Understanding of Node.js and RESTful API integration.
Eager to learn, with a passion for web development and UI design.

What's Needed -Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with version control systems like Git.
Basic understanding of state management libraries (Redux, Context API).
Knowledge of front-end build tools like Webpack or Babel.
Exposure to databases (e.g., MongoDB, MySQL) and server-side development.

Position #3: Title: Software Engineer for Backend (Java/Python )

Key Responsibilities:

Assist in developing and testing eCom backend models.
Support the implementation of Java-based frameworks like Spring, Spring Boot (OR) Python-based frameworks.
Should be able to think differently for Software Solutions.
Collaborate with team members to improve backend Services performance.
Conduct research and stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in Technology with an AI-based thought process.

What's Needed - Basic Qualifications:

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or AI.
Basic understanding of machine learning, NLP, and information retrieval.
Familiarity with programming languages like Java or Python
Exposure to machine learning libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn) is a plus.
Eager to learn and experiment with new technologies in a collaborative environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

What's Needed -Preferred Qualifications:

Adaptability, flexibility, and willingness to learn new things quickly
Demonstrated leadership qualities are a big plus
Understanding of eCom platforms is a bonus.
Basic knowledge of big data tools (Hadoop, Spark) or any NoSQL is beneficial.
Previous projects or coursework related to ML or AI are highly valued.
Enjoy working in teams and being highly communicative
Able to multitask and be flexible to new initiatives

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

About The Role

Boston Scientific was recognized by Forbes as one of the Best Workplaces for Engineers in 2026, reflecting a culture where engineers do meaningful work.

Boston Scientific is seeking a motivated R&D software engineer to join our growing Interventional Cardiology R&D team in Arbor Lakes, Minnesota. In this role, you will contribute to the design and development of medical device software that supports innovative products designed to sustain and improve the lives of patients around the world.

As an Software Engineer I
you will apply your technical, problem-solving and collaboration skills while working alongside cross-functional team members throughout the software development life cycle. This role provides an opportunity to build your technical capabilities, contribute to meaningful product development and support continuous improvement in our software development practices.

Work model, sponsorship, relocation:

At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This is an on-site role based at our Maple Grove (Arbor Lakes), Minnesota, location. Boston Scientific will not offer sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time. Relocation assistance is not available for this position at this time.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Design, implement, test and support medical device software for Windows applications.
Document software development activities in accordance with approved procedures and standards.
Create and maintain software development records using approved tracking and management tools.
Analyze, evaluate and verify software and system requirements using software engineering best practices.
Contribute to continuous improvement of processes, workflows and development methodologies by collaborating with peers and cross-functional teams.
Support project activities and collaborate with team members to help meet project goals and timelines.
Participate in reviews of software design and development activities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering or a related field.
Knowledge of Windows-based software development using Microsoft development tools.
Working knowledge of C# and C++ or similar programming languages.
Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with the Atlassian toolchain or similar software development and collaboration tools.
Experience with Windows debugging and memory management tools.
Understanding of software code optimization techniques.
Programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB.
Exposure to developing software that interfaces with custom hardware.
Familiarity with automation frameworks used to build and test software.

Maximum Salary: $ 113800

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Multimedia Lab builds highly efficient, scalable video codec hardware solutions (FPGA and ASIC) from the ground up, serving billions of users. We bring together algorithm, architecture, software, firmware, and hardware design and verification expertise, designing high-performance video silicon IP across ASIC and SoC digital design, verification, and next-generation video codec hardware. Alongside the silicon work, we advance research in video understanding, perceptual quality assessment, image and video enhancement, and intelligent coding, including using multimodal models to improve coding decisions.

Quality, efficiency, and speed rarely improve together. Sharper images and better perceived quality usually cost bitrate, compute, or latency, and a technique that works in research does not always survive production at global scale.

You will take ideas from research through to silicon and production systems, where research decisions show up in the cost and quality of video across ByteDance's products.

About The Team

Our team is building industry-leading, highly efficient and scalable video codec hardware solutions (FPGA and ASIC) from the ground up to better serve our billions of users. We are looking for strong software and firmware engineers to design algorithms, C-model, and firmware for advanced video encoding and processing implemented in dedicated hardware accelerators. The successful candidate will be part of a fast-growing team that includes algorithm, architecture, software, firmware, and hardware design and verification experts with a dedication to technical excellence and a passion to build large-scale and high-performing video platforms and services.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

Responsibilities:

Design video analysis (ROI, content understanding, feature extraction etc.) and quality assessment algorithms, and participate in database creation, algorithm design/development/optimization, etc.
Participate in designing strategy and solutions for E2E video quality optimization with a combination of video analysis, processing and encoding algorithms, such as frame-level rate control.
Apply designed algorithms for VOD / Live streaming monitoring, data analysis, objective evaluation for algorithms etc.
Collaborate with Infra and multi-media platform teams to integrate algorithms into production workflows and validate their impact through A/B testing.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)

Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline.
Excellent programming, debugging, and optimization skills in one or more general-purpose programming languages, including but not limited to: C/C++, Python.
Knowledge of image/video analysis algorithms or subjective/objective image/video quality algorithms, and state-of-the-art technologies, such as VMAF, PSNR, SSIM etc.
Hands-on experience with machine learning or deep learning and familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualification(s)

Research and hands-on experience in designing, training, or applying deep learning models, including CNNs, Transformer architectures, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs).
Knowledge of common video processing algorithms, such as super-resolution, diffusion model, etc.
Knowledge of video codecs (AVC, HEVC, AV1, VP9, etc.) and experience in video codec design.
Experience with embedded processors like ARM Cortex M0/M3/M4 or RISC-V architecture, and real-time development in an RTOS environment.
Great communication skills, eager to learn, and always passionate about turning cutting-edge technologies into real-life use cases.

Headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, Viabot builds the Viabot One, a self-charging, self-emptying sweeping robot engineered to keep facilities spotless while delivering valuable operational insights on autopilot. Powered by 3D modeling and dynamic path planning, the Viabot One navigates real-world environments and adapts to changes in its surroundings in real time. Beyond sweeping, the Viabot One continuously maps and monitors facilities, tracking activity and sending intelligent alerts to keep grounds clean and secure. With maintenance-free lithium batteries enabling quiet nightly operation and the ability to recover everything from fine dust to common debris, Viabot has helped facilities across the country achieve over 3.3 billion square feet clean, all with a true set-it-and-forget-it experience. Learn more about us at https://www.viabot.com

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate and hands-on Robotics Software Engineer to join our team. You will play a key role in building and advancing the software modules that power our mobile robots, from navigation and control to sensor integration and system deployment. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of software engineering and physical robotics, and who takes pride in writing code that runs reliably on real hardware in the real world.

Level and Experience

We’re hiring at multiple levels and welcome engineers with 2+ years of hands-on experience in mobile robotics, autonomous vehicles, or drones. Level and scope will be based on your experience, technical depth, and ownership.

What You’ll Do

Contribute to the development of robotics software components under defined architecture, performance, and reliability requirements
Work on navigation stack components, including localization, path planning, and motion control, from implementation through field validation
Implement and integrate ROS-based solutions across the full robotics software stack
Develop and test high-performance C++ code that runs reliably on embedded and edge hardware
Rapidly prototype, debug, and deploy solutions on physical robots in both simulation and real-world environments
Support sensor integration (LiDAR, camera, IMU, GPS) and participate in hardware bring-up and system-level debugging
Define and contribute to test strategies covering unit, integration, simulation-based, and hardware-in-the-loop testing
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (hardware, algorithms, QA) in an agile environment
Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and design discussions
Take increasing ownership of features from development through deployment

What You Have

Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years of hands-on experience working with mobile robots, AVs, and/or drones in research, product development, or field deployment
High proficiency in modern C++ (C++11/14/17), including performance optimization, memory management, multithreading, and debugging in Linux
Proficiency in Python for scripting, tooling, debugging, and visualization to support development and testing workflows
Hands-on experience with ROS1 and/or ROS2, including system integration, lifecycle management, and middleware-level debugging
Good understanding of robotics systems architecture, including sensors, actuators, and embedded hardware integration
Experience developing or maintaining mobile robot or drone navigation systems, including localization, mapping, and path planning
Comfortable in Linux-based environments and structured development workflows
Ability to read, understand, and modify existing robotics codebases, and to debug, test, and optimize software on physical hardware
Exceptional analytical, communication, and documentation skills, capable of thriving in a dynamic, cross-disciplinary engineering environment

Nice to Have

Exposure to deep learning, particularly as applied to perception (e.g., object detection, segmentation)
Familiarity with robotics simulation tools (Gazebo, Isaac Sim) and testing frameworks
Knowledge of SLAM, perception, and autonomy frameworks
Exposure to multi-modal sensor systems (wheel encoders, LiDAR, GPS/GNSS, cameras) for integration, synchronization, and validation

Understanding of control systems, kinematics, and dynamics
Experience with embedded or edge computing platforms

Startup mindset: proactive, adaptable, and comfortable with ambiguity

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer with a strong frontend focus to help build what’s next. In this role, you’ll work primarily in Vue, JavaScript, and TypeScript, while contributing across the stack to deliver polished customer experiences and the backend services and APIs that power them. You’ll also use AI as a core part of your development workflow and contribute to AI-powered product capabilities, including work with MCP, LLMs, and emerging technologies across Pendo.

This role is based in our Raleigh office.

What This Looks Like Day-to-day

Feature delivery: Own well-scoped features from implementation through production. Break work into small, independently shippable increments and deliver consistent progress toward team goals.
Full-stack engineering: Build across the frontend and backend, with a strong lean toward TypeScript and Vue.js. Deliver polished, reliable customer-facing experiences while contributing to the backend services and APIs that power them.
AI and MCP development: Build and expand MCP and AI-powered capabilities that help customers interact with, understand, and act on their Pendo data. Work with emerging technologies such as LLMs and agentic workflows where they support meaningful product outcomes.
Production engineering: Write maintainable, production-ready code and apply testing strategies appropriate to the risk of your changes. Follow established patterns for safe rollout, release, and operation in production.
AI-enabled development: Use AI coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow. Apply strong engineering judgment, review rigor, and accountability to AI-generated code just as you would to your own.
Technical collaboration: Participate actively in planning and technical discussions. Provide useful code review feedback and collaborate with teammates to move shared work forward.
Continuous improvement: Build deeper knowledge of the systems you work in and identify recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Raise ways to improve code quality, reliability, and how the team delivers software.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Software Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

2+ years of experience as a Software Engineer building and shipping production web applications.
Experience building full-stack applications, including backend services and APIs, with strong frontend experience using JavaScript or TypeScript and a component-based framework such as Vue, React, or Angular.
Daily use of AI tools as part of your software development workflow.
Ability to independently deliver well-scoped features and break work into small, deliverable increments.
Experience applying unit, integration, or end-to-end testing strategies appropriate to the risk and scope of a change.
Experience identifying risks and blockers in your work, raising them early, and continuing to drive progress independently.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, including participation in planning, technical discussions, and code reviews.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-haves

Experience with Vue and TypeScript.
Experience building applications that operate on large-scale datasets, including millions or billions of records, long-running queries, or asynchronous processing.
Experience building AI-powered product features using technologies such as LLM APIs, agents, or Model Context Protocol.
Experience with Go or GCP.
Familiarity with safe deployment and rollout patterns such as feature flags and canary releases.
Experience building accessible, inclusive web experiences.

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. The AI and Automation Engineer designs, prototypes, builds, integrates, evaluates, and helps productionize AI-enabled and automation solutions that address defined business and project needs. Working within TRI’s AI and Digital Enablement capability, the AI and Automation Engineer translates qualified opportunities into working solutions using established AI models and services (focused on Azure/Foundry), agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), workflow automation, data integration, and other appropriate technologies. The role emphasizes rapid experimentation, integration, and measurable evaluation, including recognizing when conventional automation or existing technology provides a better solution than AI. 
This is an applied AI engineering role, not an AI research or model-development position. The AI and Automation Engineer is not expected to develop, train, or research new foundation models. Inste.ad, the engineer selects, configures, integrates, grounds, evaluates, and applies existing models and AI services within secure enterprise solutions. The engineer works closely with Business Liaisons, business SMEs, application developers, infrastructure, and security teams to move promising concepts from prototype through evaluation, pilot, and production. Current areas of emphasis include Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services, RAG and enterprise knowledge solutions, AI agents, Power Platform automation, enterprise integration, and evaluation of solution quality, security, performance, cost, and business value. Clinical research, life sciences, regulatory or federal contracting experience.

Experience productionizing prototypes.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Cloud-Native Agent Harness (Mecatl)
jobs.description:
Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes. Kubernetes helped give enterprises more freedom over where and how they run software. Now we're bringing that same open approach to AI agents.

As AI agents take on more autonomous, long-running work, enterprises need infrastructure to run them securely and reliably at scale, without giving up control of their data, systems, or models. We're building open, Kubernetes-native infrastructure that brings together agent execution, secure access to tools and systems, and centralized controls for identity, permissions, and policy. This is an opportunity to help shape a foundational layer for enterprise AI while the architecture is still being defined.

We build in the open alongside the community. Our open source projects include ToolHive, an MCP platform that secures more than 20 million tool calls each month, and Mecatl, a cloud-native agent harness. Our commercial offering, Stacklok Enterprise, extends these capabilities with an AI gateway, centralized identity, policy enforcement, and observability.

Location

This is a remote role based in North America, with a strong preference for candidates located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone
.

The Opportunity

AI agents are moving into production, and the harness that runs them is becoming critical infrastructure. Enterprises need that harness to be secure, auditable, and portable across models, clients, and deployment environments. Mecatl is Stacklok's open source, cloud-native agent harness. It provides the agent loop, tools, permissions, hooks, delegation, and durable sessions for running agents as production workloads on infrastructure you operate.

As a Software Engineer II on the Mecatl team, you will build the platform that agents run on, and you will build it with agents. This is a hands-on role with real independence. You will deliver features and fixes across the engine, the Kubernetes-native runtime, the client surfaces (gRPC, HTTP/SSE, the TypeScript SDK, and the terminal client), and the permission and governance layers that make agent behavior safe to trust. You will go deep in one area while developing a system-wide understanding of how the harness fits together.

We are also an AI-first engineering team. We use agents throughout our own development lifecycle, and we are still working out what good looks like. Your own experiments, and what you learn from them, will feed directly into how the team works.

What Success Looks Like: First 3-6 Months

Ramped quickly on the Mecatl codebase and its development process, and began contributing independently without needing close guidance.
Shipped your first features and fixes within the first few months, then delivered core harness work consistently thereafter.
Owned a product-minded improvement end to end, from understanding how people use Mecatl to shipping a change and learning from the result.
Contributed a concrete improvement to how the team uses AI in development, such as a workflow, evaluation, guardrail, or measurement approach that the team adopted.
Strengthened the team and community by reviewing pull requests thoughtfully, including AI-assisted changes, and helping open source users get more from Mecatl.

In This Role, You Will

Build and deliver features in the open across Mecatl, including the agent loop, tool and permission systems, session and state management, the Kubernetes runtime, and client SDKs.
Fix bugs and harden the harness for production use, improving reliability, security, and observability.
Write testable, readable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling, produce clear design docs for the work you take on, and review pull requests, including AI-assisted changes.
Understand outcomes and partner with the team anchor to break down the work. Escalate decisions to product or staff engineers as needed.
Use AI agents as a core part of your own workflow, and bring a critical eye to what they produce: review it, test it, and own it.
Find where your AI workflow breaks down on Mecatl work, experiment to fix it, and bring structured findings back so the team gets faster and better, not just busier.
Apply security judgment to AI-assisted development, including permissions, secrets handling, untrusted content, and the limits of what an agent should be trusted to do.

Desired Skill & Experience

We do not expect every candidate to meet every point below. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we encourage you to apply.

Proficiency in Go, writing clean, testable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling, plus clear design docs and thoughtful code reviews.
Demonstrated ability to deliver features independently across a backend or platform codebase, from implementation through testing and into a release.
Working knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-native infrastructure, such as Kubernetes, containers, and service APIs (gRPC or HTTP). Experience with durable state, concurrency, or streaming is a plus.
A personal AI-assisted development workflow you can walk through, with a clear sense of where it helps, where it breaks, and its risks, such as prompt injection and excessive agent permissions.
Interest in agent infrastructure, such as agent loops, tool use, MCP, model providers, or evaluation. Prior experience building on or contributing to an AI platform or open source project is a plus.
Ideally, a product engineering mindset: curious about users and their problems, comfortable questioning requirements, and motivated by shipping something people use.
AI-first mindset: builds AI into the development workflow to accelerate delivery, improve the quality of what ships, and rethink how problems get solved.
Communication: excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain complex technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Startup mentality and intrinsic motivation: self-directed and hands-on, thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, and drives clarity through action.

Compensation:
The anticipated base salary range for this position is $157,500 - $192,500
. In addition to base salary, this role offers equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Join Us?

At Stacklok, we believe great technology is built by teams that support, challenge, and inspire one another. We are AI maximalists, confident in AI's potential and committed to building technology people can trust. We use AI in our own work and experiment openly.

You'll build alongside people with deep experience in open source, cloud-native technologies, security, and developer tools. The Team + The Role

Pendo’s feature teams build the experiences that help customers understand their users, improve their products, and get more value from their software. In this role, you’ll work primarily in Vue, JavaScript, and TypeScript, while contributing across the stack to deliver polished customer experiences and the backend services and APIs that power them. You’ll also use AI as a core part of your development workflow and contribute to AI-powered product capabilities, including work with MCP, LLMs, and emerging technologies across Pendo.

This role is based in our Raleigh office.

What This Looks Like Day-to-day

Feature delivery: Own well-scoped features from implementation through production. Break work into small, independently shippable increments and deliver consistent progress toward team goals.
Full-stack engineering: Build across the frontend and backend, with a strong lean toward TypeScript and Vue.js. Deliver polished, reliable customer-facing experiences while contributing to the backend services and APIs that power them.
AI and MCP development: Build and expand MCP and AI-powered capabilities that help customers interact with, understand, and act on their Pendo data. Work with emerging technologies such as LLMs and agentic workflows where they support meaningful product outcomes.
Production engineering: Write maintainable, production-ready code and apply testing strategies appropriate to the risk of your changes. Follow established patterns for safe rollout, release, and operation in production.
AI-enabled development: Use AI coding tools as a core part of your daily workflow. Apply strong engineering judgment, review rigor, and accountability to AI-generated code just as you would to your own.
Technical collaboration: Participate actively in planning and technical discussions. Provide useful code review feedback and collaborate with teammates to move shared work forward.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Software Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

2+ years of experience as a Software Engineer building and shipping production web applications.
Experience building full-stack applications, including backend services and APIs, with strong frontend experience using JavaScript or TypeScript and a component-based framework such as Vue, React, or Angular.
Daily use of AI tools as part of your software development workflow.
Ability to independently deliver well-scoped features and break work into small, deliverable increments.
Experience applying unit, integration, or end-to-end testing strategies appropriate to the risk and scope of a change.
Experience identifying risks and blockers in your work, raising them early, and continuing to drive progress independently.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, including participation in planning, technical discussions, and code reviews.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-haves

Experience with Vue and TypeScript.
Experience building applications that operate on large-scale datasets, including millions or billions of records, long-running queries, or asynchronous processing.
Experience building AI-powered product features using technologies such as LLM APIs, agents, or Model Context Protocol.
Experience with Go or GCP.
Familiarity with safe deployment and rollout patterns such as feature flags and canary releases.
Experience building accessible, inclusive web experiences.

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. This role is based in our Raleigh office.

What this looks like day-to-day

End-to-end feature ownership: Own complex, ambiguous features from problem definition through delivery. Break work into small, independently shippable increments to maintain consistent progress and deliver customer value.
Production-quality engineering: Write reliable, maintainable production code and select testing approaches based on risk and system impact. Apply safe rollout patterns, including feature flags and incremental deployments, to reduce delivery risk.
Production reliability: Respond quickly to production issues within your area of ownership and drive them to resolution. Identify root causes and implement improvements that prevent recurring problems.
AI-enabled development: Integrate AI tools into daily engineering workflows for code generation, debugging, test writing, and task decomposition. Share effective practices that improve how the team uses AI to build and deliver software.
Technical collaboration: Provide actionable code reviews and contribute constructively to engineering discussions and planning. Partner with product, design, and fellow engineers to align technical decisions with product outcomes.
Continuous improvement: Identify recurring friction in code, tests, tooling, and development processes. Proactively implement improvements that strengthen engineering quality and team efficiency.
Clear technical communication: Create documentation, commit messages, and technical notes that make decisions and implementation details easy to understand. Maintain enough written context for teammates to continue work without requiring verbal handoffs.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. Software Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

5+ years of software engineering experience delivering customer-facing SaaS product features in production environments.
Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language: Go, Java, Python, or C++.
Deep understanding of scalable web architecture, API design, and performance optimization.
Experience with AWS or GCP cloud platforms and both SQL and NoSQL databases.
Demonstrated ability to independently structure ambiguous technical work into small, deliverable increments and drive execution through completion.
Experience designing and implementing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, with sound judgment about when to apply each approach.
Familiarity with safe deployment and rollout practices, including feature flags, canary releases, or comparable approaches.
Active use of AI tools in software development workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and design teams.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice-to-haves

Experience improving team-level engineering tooling, development processes, or developer workflows beyond individual feature delivery.
Experience mentoring engineers and strengthening team capabilities through technical documentation, constructive code reviews, or knowledge sharing.
Experience contributing to shared platform capabilities that support multiple product areas.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values:
Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location:

Applications are accepted until further notice.   

This role may be eligible for remote work in the United States depending on business needs and hiring manager approval.

Meet the Team

Our dedicated team members are building the future of Cisco’s AI-driven platforms and data infrastructure, supporting innovation across the globe. You will join teams focused on developing advanced data pipelines, machine learning infrastructure, and analytics platforms within business groups such as S&TO, Supply Chain, and Infrastructure Engineering. As part of this collaborative environment, you will contribute to the growth of emerging technologies in data and intelligent systems. Explore the opportunities at the intersection of data engineering and AI, helping to transform how Cisco and its customers harness information and intelligent automation. 

Your Impact

You are a passionate software engineer with expertise in developing scalable data pipelines, designing robust analytics platforms, and building infrastructure to support machine learning initiatives. Your strong background in programming, data systems, and collaboration enables you to solve complex challenges with innovation and attention to detail. By building and maintaining key software tools and platforms, you enable Cisco’s business groups to leverage AI and data-driven insights for operational excellence and strategic growth. Your work ensures high-quality, reliable data infrastructure that supports Cisco’s leadership in intelligent, scalable technology solutions. 

Minimum Qualifications 

Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months): 
A Master's degree with 0 years of work experience; or 
A Bachelor's degree with 2 years of work experience; or 
An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Associate’s, Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) with 3 years of work experience; or 
A High school diploma (or equivalent) with 4 years of work experience. 
Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, IT, or a related program.   
Proficiency in Python or another programming language, with a strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.  
Foundational knowledge of data analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or related concepts, gained through coursework, projects, research, internships, or other hands-on experience.  
Familiarity with data technologies and tools, such as SQL, data processing frameworks, machine learning libraries, or cloud platforms, with the ability to learn and apply new technologies. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Hands-on experience with AI/ML.   
Familiarity with major cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.   
Proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.    
Familiarity with distributed data processing and containerization/orchestration technologies, such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, Apache Flink, Docker, or Kubernetes.  
Understanding of distributed systems concepts, including scalability, reliability, fault tolerance, and data consistency, as well as familiarity with distributed computing patterns (e.g., load balancing, consensus algorithms, and inter-service communication).  

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Satellite Flight Software Engineer - TeraWave
new_jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.

Job Description

This position is part of Blue Origin's TeraWave business unit, a newly announced satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. TeraWave consists of 5,408 optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise-grade connectivity for critical operations.

We are seeking a Senior Satellite Flight Software Engineer to provide technical expertise for TeraWave's Satellite Flight Software Subsystem. This role will be instrumental in developing robust, scalable flight software to support the growth of TeraWave into a 5,408-vehicle constellation. The ideal candidate is a hands-on flight software architect who will shape software architecture, drive cross-functional integration, and establish high standards for software quality, verification, security, and maintainability across the full flight software lifecycle.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Architect, design, develop, and integrate core flight software for a next-generation satellite platform
Define scalable, reusable, and platform-independent flight software frameworks, services, and design patterns to support multiple spacecraft configurations and future growth
Architect, develop, and evolve key flight software components including core services, command and data handling (C&DH), telemetry, health monitoring, and fault-management infrastructure
Establish software architecture standards, coding guidelines, design patterns, and review practices to ensure maintainability, reliability, and mission readiness
Partner closely with systems, avionics, GNC, communications, power, propulsion, thermal, payload, and autonomy teams to translate vehicle and subsystem-level requirements into robust software implementations
Conduct software design reviews, code reviews, and technical trade studies related to performance, fault tolerance, redundancy, scalability, and portability
Support software integration, verification, and validation in software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and other mission-representative test environments
Develop and improve software engineering infrastructure including build systems, CI/CD pipelines, automated test frameworks, and debugging/diagnostic tools
Contribute to technical documentation including software architecture descriptions, interface control documents, verification plans, and test procedures
Design and implement secure OTA software update capabilities for spacecraft, including validation, authenticated delivery, rollback, version control, and safe deployment in mission-critical on-orbit environments
Ensure flight software architecture and implementation incorporate cybersecurity principles such as secure communications, access control, interface hardening, and resilient software design

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical field
8+ years of experience developing embedded software for spacecraft or other mission-critical real-time systems
Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python
Experience with RTOS-based embedded software development with Embedded Linux, VxWorks, or QNX
Experience architecting and implementing complex flight software or mission-critical embedded software systems
Demonstrated technical depth across software design, implementation, and cross-functional integration
Experience with software lifecycle, configuration management, CI/CD, and verification/validation practices for mission-critical systems
Familiarity with communication protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, CAN, I2C, SPI, and RS-422/485
Experience applying secure software development and cybersecurity best practices in embedded or mission-critical systems
Experience with embedded software testing methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience with flight software frameworks such as core Flight System (cFS), F Prime, or similar
Experience developing software for satellite constellations, distributed space systems, or networked embedded platforms
Knowledge of satellite communications systems, spacecraft networking, and high-throughput data handling
Experience with software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and integrated spacecraft test environments
Experience with fault-tolerant computing, redundancy management, and resilient software architectures
Knowledge of radiation-hardened computing environments and software considerations for spaceflight
Experience with communication satellite systems, optical inter-satellite links, or related networking technologies
Experience designing secure over-the-air (OTA) software update mechanisms for embedded or mission-critical systems
Experience with software build systems, static analysis, code quality tooling, or automated verification frameworks for embedded systems

Why Blue Origin

At Blue Origin, we’re building the future of space-based connectivity through the TeraWave satellite communications network. As a Senior Satellite Flight Software Developer, you will help define the software architecture, engineering rigor, and technical foundation for a large-scale satellite constellation delivering high-performance, resilient global communications. Join a team solving complex, mission-critical problems at the intersection of spacecraft, software, networking, and system integration.

Join our team and be part of building a space-based network designed for tomorrow, where your expertise will directly contribute to creating a system that provides connectivity anywhere on Earth.

Base Pay Range For

CA applicants is $197,529.00 - $276,539.55 CO applicants is $181,626.00 - $254,275.35 WA applicants is $197,529.00 - $276,539.55

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Background Check

Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.

Benefits

new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Multimedia Lab builds highly efficient, scalable video codec hardware solutions (FPGA and ASIC) from the ground up, serving billions of users. We bring together algorithm, architecture, software, firmware, and hardware design and verification expertise, designing high-performance video silicon IP across ASIC and SoC digital design, verification, and next-generation video codec hardware. Alongside the silicon work, we advance research in video understanding, perceptual quality assessment, image and video enhancement, and intelligent coding, including using multimodal models to improve coding decisions.

Quality, efficiency, and speed rarely improve together. Sharper images and better perceived quality usually cost bitrate, compute, or latency, and a technique that works in research does not always survive production at global scale.

You will take ideas from research through to silicon and production systems, where research decisions show up in the cost and quality of video across ByteDance's products.

About The Team

Our team is building industry-leading, highly efficient and scalable video codec hardware solutions (FPGA and ASIC) from the ground up to better serve our billions of users. We are looking for strong software and firmware engineers to design algorithms, C-model, and firmware for advanced video encoding and processing implemented in dedicated hardware accelerators. The successful candidate will be part of a fast-growing team that includes algorithm, architecture, software, firmware, and hardware design and verification experts with a dedication to technical excellence and a passion to build large-scale and high-performing video platforms and services.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

Responsibilities:

Design video analysis (ROI, content understanding, feature extraction etc.) and quality assessment algorithms, and participate in database creation, algorithm design/development/optimization, etc.
Participate in designing strategy and solutions for E2E video quality optimization with a combination of video analysis, processing and encoding algorithms, such as frame-level rate control.
Apply designed algorithms for VOD / Live streaming monitoring, data analysis, objective evaluation for algorithms etc.
Collaborate with Infra and multi-media platform teams to integrate algorithms into production workflows and validate their impact through A/B testing.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)

Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline.
Excellent programming, debugging, and optimization skills in one or more general-purpose programming languages, including but not limited to: C/C++, Python.
Knowledge of image/video analysis algorithms or subjective/objective image/video quality algorithms, and state-of-the-art technologies, such as VMAF, PSNR, SSIM etc.
Hands-on experience with machine learning or deep learning and familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualification(s)

Research and hands-on experience in designing, training, or applying deep learning models, including CNNs, Transformer architectures, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs).
Knowledge of common video processing algorithms, such as super-resolution, diffusion model, etc.
Knowledge of video codecs (AVC, HEVC, AV1, VP9, etc.) and experience in video codec design.
Experience with embedded processors like ARM Cortex M0/M3/M4 or RISC-V architecture, and real-time development in an RTOS environment.
Great communication skills, eager to learn, and always passionate about turning cutting-edge technologies into real-life use cases.

The Software Engineer will collaborate with a skilled and dedicated team to advance and expand the digital solutions available in Intuitive’s surgical robotic product portfolio. To excel, you must thrive in a dynamic and focused team setting, possess outstanding communication abilities, and balance independent work with effective teamwork during all phases of planning, development, integration, and assessment of exploratory concepts and initial product versions.

A strong candidate will quickly become familiar with existing systems and devise innovative, yet practical solutions based on requirements. You’ll be supported by a caring management and development team dedicated to your professional success.

Build and sustain embedded software solutions utilizing network communication protocols such as TCP/IP, WebSocket, and MQTT, ensuring seamless integration with scalable cloud environments (including AWS VPC, EC2, and ELB).
Perform root cause analysis and address issues for products in both released and production stages.

Implement encryption, authentication, and authorization where necessary.

Contribute to formal risk analysis (such as FMEA) and develop software-based mitigations to address identified risks

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Experience with AWS IoT cloud development is highly desirable

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Cloud-Native Agent Harness (Mecatl)
new_jobs.description:
Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes. Kubernetes helped give enterprises more freedom over where and how they run software. Now we're bringing that same open approach to AI agents.

As AI agents take on more autonomous, long-running work, enterprises need infrastructure to run them securely and reliably at scale, without giving up control of their data, systems, or models. We're building open, Kubernetes-native infrastructure that brings together agent execution, secure access to tools and systems, and centralized controls for identity, permissions, and policy. This is an opportunity to help shape a foundational layer for enterprise AI while the architecture is still being defined.

We build in the open alongside the community. Our open source projects include ToolHive, an MCP platform that secures more than 20 million tool calls each month, and Mecatl, a cloud-native agent harness. Our commercial offering, Stacklok Enterprise, extends these capabilities with an AI gateway, centralized identity, policy enforcement, and observability.

Location

This is a remote role based in North America, with a strong preference for candidates located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone
.

The Opportunity

AI agents are moving into production, and the harness that runs them is becoming critical infrastructure. Enterprises need that harness to be secure, auditable, and portable across models, clients, and deployment environments. Mecatl is Stacklok's open source, cloud-native agent harness. It provides the agent loop, tools, permissions, hooks, delegation, and durable sessions for running agents as production workloads on infrastructure you operate.

As a Software Engineer II on the Mecatl team, you will build the platform that agents run on, and you will build it with agents. This is a hands-on role with real independence. You will deliver features and fixes across the engine, the Kubernetes-native runtime, the client surfaces (gRPC, HTTP/SSE, the TypeScript SDK, and the terminal client), and the permission and governance layers that make agent behavior safe to trust. You will go deep in one area while developing a system-wide understanding of how the harness fits together.

We are also an AI-first engineering team. We use agents throughout our own development lifecycle, and we are still working out what good looks like. Your own experiments, and what you learn from them, will feed directly into how the team works.

What Success Looks Like: First 3-6 Months

Ramped quickly on the Mecatl codebase and its development process, and began contributing independently without needing close guidance.
Shipped your first features and fixes within the first few months, then delivered core harness work consistently thereafter.
Owned a product-minded improvement end to end, from understanding how people use Mecatl to shipping a change and learning from the result.
Contributed a concrete improvement to how the team uses AI in development, such as a workflow, evaluation, guardrail, or measurement approach that the team adopted.
Strengthened the team and community by reviewing pull requests thoughtfully, including AI-assisted changes, and helping open source users get more from Mecatl.

In This Role, You Will

Build and deliver features in the open across Mecatl, including the agent loop, tool and permission systems, session and state management, the Kubernetes runtime, and client SDKs.
Fix bugs and harden the harness for production use, improving reliability, security, and observability.
Write testable, readable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling, produce clear design docs for the work you take on, and review pull requests, including AI-assisted changes.
Understand outcomes and partner with the team anchor to break down the work. Escalate decisions to product or staff engineers as needed.
Use AI agents as a core part of your own workflow, and bring a critical eye to what they produce: review it, test it, and own it.
Find where your AI workflow breaks down on Mecatl work, experiment to fix it, and bring structured findings back so the team gets faster and better, not just busier.
Apply security judgment to AI-assisted development, including permissions, secrets handling, untrusted content, and the limits of what an agent should be trusted to do.

Desired Skill & Experience

We do not expect every candidate to meet every point below. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we encourage you to apply.

Proficiency in Go, writing clean, testable code that accounts for edge cases and error handling, plus clear design docs and thoughtful code reviews.
Demonstrated ability to deliver features independently across a backend or platform codebase, from implementation through testing and into a release.
Working knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-native infrastructure, such as Kubernetes, containers, and service APIs (gRPC or HTTP). Experience with durable state, concurrency, or streaming is a plus.
A personal AI-assisted development workflow you can walk through, with a clear sense of where it helps, where it breaks, and its risks, such as prompt injection and excessive agent permissions.
Interest in agent infrastructure, such as agent loops, tool use, MCP, model providers, or evaluation. Prior experience building on or contributing to an AI platform or open source project is a plus.
Ideally, a product engineering mindset: curious about users and their problems, comfortable questioning requirements, and motivated by shipping something people use.
AI-first mindset: builds AI into the development workflow to accelerate delivery, improve the quality of what ships, and rethink how problems get solved.
Communication: excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain complex technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Startup mentality and intrinsic motivation: self-directed and hands-on, thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, and drives clarity through action.

Compensation:
The anticipated base salary range for this position is $157,500 - $192,500
. In addition to base salary, this role offers equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Join Us?

At Stacklok, we believe great technology is built by teams that support, challenge, and inspire one another. We are AI maximalists, confident in AI's potential and committed to building technology people can trust. We use AI in our own work and experiment openly.

You'll build alongside people with deep experience in open source, cloud-native technologies, security, and developer tools. We stay close to customers, use our own products, and share what we learn to keep improving. You'll have room to make decisions, support when you need it, and teammates who push themselves to do their best work.

We offer competitive compensation and equity, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and a flexible hybrid or remote work environment. Our benefits include flexible PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave, along with team offsites to collaborate and connect in person.

If you're excited about what we're building and want to work with people who care about their craft, community, and each other, we'd love to hear from you.

Pendo’s feature teams build the experiences that help customers understand their users, improve their products, and get more value from their software.
